title: Advance-Booking Discount, Bluegate Moving Truck Rental First Day
content:
**Advance booking terms.** The Bluegate Moving Truck Rental first-day advance-booking discount depends on the calendar days from the reservation date to the scheduled pickup date:

- **14** or more days take a discount of **0.1**;
- at least **7** but fewer than 14 days take **0.05**;
- fewer days take no advance-booking discount.

This discount is a fraction taken off the day-rated first-day fee, added together with any other first-day discount fraction and taken off in one single step; rounding to the cent comes once, on the final fee.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical scheduled pickup on 15 May)

| Reservation date | Calendar days to the scheduled pickup date | Advance-booking discount |
|---|---|---|
| 1 May | 14 | 0.1 |
| 2 May | 13 | 0.05 |
| 8 May | 7 | 0.05 |
| 9 May | 6 | None |

The reservation date is the date the reservation was made, as it stands on the reservation record; a later change of the pickup date changes the count, since the count runs to the scheduled pickup date then on the contract.
